encounter.title: Combat pressure 2 — a mistake now costs HP

phases.label: passive mob, does not attack yet

encounter.notes: tiny 4x5, 4 arrows: N=1 E=2 S=0 W=1. Only one of the two E arrows (#1) is free at start; the other (#3) is blocked and only frees after clearing #0 (N) then #2 (W). Reused from EXP-009's E2 (same seed, same shape) because it already puts a second, still-blocked E arrow in plain sight next to the free one -- a natural blocked-tap temptation, now with a real cost: blockedTapDamage 1. No enemy attack timer yet, per docs/COMBAT-RULES.md 10 (encounter 2 introduces the blocked-tap cost, not the attack timer). Provisional: the exact damage value (1) is tuning, not user-approved.
